behavior: Jobs has a separate collection-source selector; application route providers and verified ATS classification remain distinct.
Selecting a configured source filters recorded jobs in the database before LIMIT and rejects an unknown source ID.
The source ID persists in profile-owned saved-search filters and restores/clears through the connected Jobs UI; old saved searches default to no source filter.
Filtering and saving do not enqueue or schedule collection.
not_run: Hosted Actions or hosted review (local-only policy)

safety.test_data: Synthetic local profiles, jobs, and sources only.

remaining_requirement_gaps: This is one connected facet of MJ-REQ-189; the requirement remains PARTIAL until all original search controls and complete acceptance are verified.
The filter reads the canonical job's recorded source_id attribution; multi-source posting provenance remains governed by existing source-history behavior.
